# Samples Wala

> Samples Wala is the premier royalty-free Indian music sample library and digital sound marketplace. It provides authentic, studio-grade Indian loops, one-shots, vocal chops, and percussion packs for music producers, composers, and sound designers worldwide.

## Key Features
- **100% Royalty-Free:** All sounds are cleared for commercial use in streaming (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube), film, TV, OTT, gaming, and commercial releases with zero royalty splits or hidden fees.
- **Studio-Grade Quality:** Delivered in pristine 24-bit WAV format, 44.1kHz / 48kHz, fully tagged with accurate BPM, musical key, and genre metadata.
- **Instant Digital Download:** Secure, fast delivery of ZIP archives containing lossless audio files.

## Sound Categories & Genres
- **Indian Percussion & Rhythms:** Dholak, Tabla, Dhol, Kanjira, Ghungroo, Naal, Duff, South Indian rhythms, Punjabi Bhangra, and Tapori Mumbai street beats.
- **Indian Melodies & Instruments:** Sitar, Bansuri (Indian Bamboo Flute), Shehnai, Sarangi, Tumbi, Mandolin, Harmonium, and Indian Strings.
- **Vocals & Chants:** Traditional Sufi chants, Bollywood female & male vocal hooks, Punjabi folk shouts, alaaps, and cinematic classical vocal phrases.
- **Modern Fusion:** Bollywood Lo-Fi, Indian Trap, Desi Hip-Hop, Drill, Afro-Desi, and Cinematic World Music.
